newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Enerco reports strong revenue rise.
newsitem.headline: Enerco reports strong revenue rise.

text.p: Gas retailer Enerco New Zealand Ltd said on Friday total revenue from customers -- from gas sales, appliance sales, installation and servicing -- totalled $190 million in 1996-97, up 13.4 percent on the previous year.
Enerco lifted its after-tax operating profit by 16 percent to a record $18.9 millin for the year ended March 31.
Earnings before interest and tax were up 13.4 percent to $29 million.
Towards year end, Enerco achieved over 100,000 customers, having made 11,623 new connections, against a target of 10,000. Half the growth came in greater Auckland.

The company's network has been independently triennially revalued at March 31 using the recognised Optimised Deprival Value method. This resulted in an increase over existing book value of $58.1 million to $265.7 million.
This is the principal reason for the increase in shareholders' equity from $225.7 million to $289.1 million 12 months later.

Enerco expects financial benefits in 1997/98 from centralising management and amalgamating the four regional companies into a single operating entity. Greater benefits are expected the following year.
